# Generated by "Claude files/tools/build_gnomish_workshop.py" from gnomish_data.py. Change the tables there and re-run.

# Plain ifs only (doc 35: EU4 drops events, tiers and privileges after an else in a scripted effect).

# ---- The Gommo Artificer Corps (doc 48, section 3): events .11 and .14 in one, without their requirements ----
DA_GN_artificer_corps = {
	set_country_flag = DA_GN_corps
	set_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GN_Corps
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_enable_metallurgy_System } }
		set_country_flag = DA_enable_metallurgy_System
		DA_enable_Metal_Infan = yes
		DA_initialize_metallurgy_variables = { DA_unit = INFAN }
		DA_initialize_metallurgy_variables = { DA_unit = CAVAL }
		DA_initialize_metallurgy_variables = { DA_unit = ARTIL }
		clr_country_flag = DA_redesigning_Infantry
		clr_country_flag = DA_redesigning_Cavalry
		clr_country_flag = DA_redesigning_Artillery
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_enable_metallurgy_System_artificer } }
		set_country_flag = DA_enable_metallurgy_System_artificer
		DA_remove_metallurgy_infcav_modifiers_effect = { DA_unit = INFAN }
		DA_remove_Unique_Metallurgy_modifiers = { DA_unit = INFAN }
		DA_initialize_metallurgy_variables = { DA_unit = INFAN }
		DA_remove_Unique_Metallurgy_modifiers_flags = { DA_unit = INFAN }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_metallurgy_show_INFAN }
			clr_country_flag = DA_metallurgy_show_INFAN
			set_country_flag = DA_metallurgy_show_ARTIFICER
		}
		remove_country_modifier = DA_metallurgy_infantry_modifier_fake
	}
}
# Day one, or when the estate appears: a gnomish country with the Artificers estate (the culture is read live).
DA_GN_corps_check = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_corps }
			DA_RH_is_gnomish = yes
			has_estate = estate_artificers
		}
		set_country_flag = DA_GN_corps
		country_event = { id = DA_GN_event.1 }
	}
}

# ---- The bench ----
# months: plain; fast: Brillite Method; eng: the Great Ideation Engine; both: the two together.
DA_GN_start_job = {
	set_country_flag = DA_GN_bench_busy
	set_variable = { which = DA_GN_job value = $code$ }
	set_variable = { which = DA_GN_job_progress value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_GN_job_pct value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_GN_job_months value = $months$ }
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GN_Brillite NOT = { DA_GN_engine_on = yes } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_GN_job_months value = $fast$ }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GN_Brillite } DA_GN_engine_on = yes }
		set_variable = { which = DA_GN_job_months value = $eng$ }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GN_Brillite DA_GN_engine_on = yes }
		set_variable = { which = DA_GN_job_months value = $both$ }
	}
}
DA_GN_job_percent = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GN_job_months value = 1 } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_GN_job_pct which = DA_GN_job_progress }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_GN_job_pct value = 100 }
		divide_variable = { which = DA_GN_job_pct which = DA_GN_job_months }
	}
}
# Monthly, only for a country with a commission on the bench (DA_GN_on_actions.txt). It waits while the bench is
# closed (gnomes not the primary heritage): the commission keeps its progress (doc 48, section 10).
DA_GN_bench_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { DA_GN_has_bench = yes }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GN_job_progress value = 1 }
		DA_GN_job_percent = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GN_job_progress which = DA_GN_job_months } }
			clr_country_flag = DA_GN_bench_busy
			country_event = { id = DA_GN_event.2 }
		}
	}
}
DA_GN_start_proto_cocolocogram = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_misfire.cocolocogram }
		add_treasury = -75
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_misfire.cocolocogram } }
		add_treasury = -150
	}
	custom_tooltip = DA_GN_proto_go_tt.cocolocogram
	hidden_effect = { DA_GN_start_job = { code = 101 months = 6 fast = 5 eng = 4 both = 4 } }
}

# Assay a Relic (doc 72): a relic sample, the price, the bench; half the time with the Precursor Script Tables
DA_GN_start_assay = {
	add_treasury = -100
	custom_tooltip = DA_GN_sample_pay_tt
	hidden_effect = { change_variable = { which = DA_GN_samples value = -1 } }
	custom_tooltip = DA_GN_assay_go_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GN_Script_Tables }
			DA_GN_start_job = { code = 700 months = 3 fast = 2 eng = 2 both = 2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GN_Script_Tables } }
			DA_GN_start_job = { code = 700 months = 6 fast = 5 eng = 4 both = 4 }
		}
	}
}
# The Precursor view of the Patents page: the three Precursor patents, the assays, the surveys
DA_GN_toggle_pv = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_pv }
		clr_country_flag = DA_GN_pv
		set_variable = { which = DA_GN_sel value = 1 }
		set_country_flag = DA_GN_pv_was
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_pv_was } }
		set_country_flag = DA_GN_pv
		set_variable = { which = DA_GN_sel value = 15 }
	}
	clr_country_flag = DA_GN_pv_was
}
# The Great Ideation Engine: a commission from the International Gommo view of the Workshop.
DA_GN_start_engine = {
	add_treasury = -3000
	custom_tooltip = DA_GN_mat_pay_tt.metal.100
	hidden_effect = { change_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = -100 } }
	custom_tooltip = DA_GN_mat_pay_tt.building.50
	hidden_effect = { change_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = -50 } }
	custom_tooltip = DA_GN_engine_go_tt
	hidden_effect = { DA_GN_start_job = { code = 600 months = 36 fast = 29 eng = 27 both = 22 } }
}
# A Gommo branch: the on_accept of DA_GN_open_branch (ROOT us, FROM the host).
DA_GN_start_branch = {
	add_treasury = -500
	custom_tooltip = DA_GN_mat_pay_tt.building.10
	hidden_effect = { change_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = -10 } }
	custom_tooltip = DA_GN_branch_go_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		FROM = { set_country_flag = DA_GN_branch_pending_@ROOT }
		DA_GN_start_job = { code = 500 months = 12 fast = 10 eng = 9 both = 7 }
	}
}

# The branch opens if the host is still our ally or subject (report 8); if not, the money and the materials
# come back (report 9). The host is saved as the event target DA_GN_branch_host for the report (DA_GN_event.7).
DA_GN_finish_branch = {
	set_variable = { which = DA_GN_report value = 9 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_branch_pending_@ROOT }
		clr_country_flag = DA_GN_branch_pending_@ROOT
		save_event_target_as = DA_GN_branch_host
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { alliance_with = ROOT is_subject_of = ROOT } }
			set_country_flag = DA_GN_branch_@ROOT
			ROOT = { set_variable = { which = DA_GN_report value = 8 } }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GN_report value = 9 } }
		add_treasury = 500
		change_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = 10 }
	}
	DA_GN_branches_upkeep = yes
}
DA_GN_finish_proto_cocolocogram = {
	set_variable = { which = DA_GN_report_patent value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GN_Brillite } }
		set_country_flag = DA_GN_proto.cocolocogram
		clr_country_flag = DA_GN_misfire.cocolocogram
		set_variable = { which = DA_GN_report value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GN_Brillite }
		random_list = {
			15 = {
				set_country_flag = DA_GN_proto.cocolocogram
				clr_country_flag = DA_GN_misfire.cocolocogram
				set_country_flag = DA_GN_up.cocolocogram.1
				set_variable = { which = DA_GN_report value = 2 }
			}
			10 = {
				set_country_flag = DA_GN_misfire.cocolocogram
				set_variable = { which = DA_GN_report value = 3 }
			}
			75 = {
				set_country_flag = DA_GN_proto.cocolocogram
				clr_country_flag = DA_GN_misfire.cocolocogram
				set_variable = { which = DA_GN_report value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

DA_GN_finish_assay = {
	set_variable = { which = DA_GN_report value = 11 }
	clr_country_flag = DA_GN_assay_patent
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GN_Reverse OR = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_pre.lenses } NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_pre.lockers } NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_pre.coils } } }
		random_list = {
			25 = { set_country_flag = DA_GN_assay_patent }
			75 = { }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_assay_patent }
		set_variable = { which = DA_GN_report value = 12 }
		random_list = {
			1 = {
				trigger = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_pre.lenses } }
				set_country_flag = DA_GN_pre.lenses
				set_variable = { which = DA_GN_report_patent value = 15 }
			}
			1 = {
				trigger = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_pre.lockers } }
				set_country_flag = DA_GN_pre.lockers
				set_variable = { which = DA_GN_report_patent value = 16 }
			}
			1 = {
				trigger = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_pre.coils } }
				set_country_flag = DA_GN_pre.coils
				set_variable = { which = DA_GN_report_patent value = 17 }
			}
		}
		clr_country_flag = DA_GN_assay_patent
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GN_report value = 11 } }
		random_list = {
			1 = { set_variable = { which = DA_GN_assay_school value = 1 } }
			1 = { set_variable = { which = DA_GN_assay_school value = 2 } }
			1 = { set_variable = { which = DA_GN_assay_school value = 3 } }
			1 = { set_variable = { which = DA_GN_assay_school value = 4 } }
			1 = { set_variable = { which = DA_GN_assay_school value = 5 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GN_assay_school value = 1 } }
			DA_research_school_exp = { school = Metallurgy }
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GN_Script_Tables } DA_research_school_exp = { school = Metallurgy } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GN_assay_school value = 2 } }
			DA_research_school_exp = { school = Mechanics }
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GN_Script_Tables } DA_research_school_exp = { school = Mechanics } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GN_assay_school value = 3 } }
			DA_research_school_exp = { school = Alchemy }
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GN_Script_Tables } DA_research_school_exp = { school = Alchemy } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GN_assay_school value = 4 } }
			DA_research_school_exp = { school = Medicine }
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GN_Script_Tables } DA_research_school_exp = { school = Medicine } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_GN_assay_school value = 5 } }
			DA_research_school_exp = { school = Arcane_Arts }
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GN_Script_Tables } DA_research_school_exp = { school = Arcane_Arts } }
		}
	}
}

# ---- Patents: switched on and off on Anbennar's artifice capacity (the Pioneer pattern, DA_SS_reconcile_capacity) ----
# Takes the booking off ArtificeUpkeep, counts it again from the flags, adds it back and lets Anbennar recount.
# Every patent switches off when the gnomish heritage is dormant, the Artificers estate is gone or artificery is.
DA_GN_reconcile_capacity = {
	subtract_variable = { which = ArtificeUpkeep which = DA_GN_booked_capacity }
	set_variable = { which = DA_GN_booked_capacity value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_GN_on_count value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { DA_GN_patents_allowed = yes } }
		clr_country_flag = DA_GN_on.cocolocogram
		clr_country_flag = DA_GN_on.recuverinator
		clr_country_flag = DA_GN_on.dynamos
		clr_country_flag = DA_GN_on.bombards
		clr_country_flag = DA_GN_on.crammers
		clr_country_flag = DA_GN_on.spyglass
		clr_country_flag = DA_GN_on.monocles
		clr_country_flag = DA_GN_on.looms
		clr_country_flag = DA_GN_on.cranes
		clr_country_flag = DA_GN_on.tugs
		clr_country_flag = DA_GN_on.walking
		clr_country_flag = DA_GN_on.ledgers
		clr_country_flag = DA_GN_on.arcades
		clr_country_flag = DA_GN_on.bulkheads
		clr_country_flag = DA_GN_on.lenses
		clr_country_flag = DA_GN_on.lockers
		clr_country_flag = DA_GN_on.coils
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GN_lic_count value = 1 } }
			DA_GN_licences_upkeep = yes	# their licences end with them
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_on.cocolocogram }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GN_on_count value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GN_Mechanist }
			change_variable = { which = DA_GN_booked_capacity value = 8 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GN_Mechanist } }
			change_variable = { which = DA_GN_booked_capacity value = 10 }
		}
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GN_pat_cocolocogram duration = -1 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_up.cocolocogram.1 }
			add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GN_pat_cocolocogram_1 duration = -1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_up.cocolocogram.2 }
			add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GN_pat_cocolocogram_2 duration = -1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_on.cocolocogram } }
		remove_country_modifier = DA_GN_pat_cocolocogram
		remove_country_modifier = DA_GN_pat_cocolocogram_1
		remove_country_modifier = DA_GN_pat_cocolocogram_2
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_on.recuverinator }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GN_on_count value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GN_Mechanist }
			change_variable = { which = DA_GN_booked_capacity value = 8 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GN_Mechanist } }
			change_variable = { which = DA_GN_booked_capacity value = 10 }
		}
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GN_pat_recuverinator duration = -1 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_up.recuverinator.1 }
			add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GN_pat_recuverinator_1 duration = -1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_up.recuverinator.2 }
			add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GN_pat_recuverinator_2 duration = -1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_on.recuverinator } }
		remove_country_modifier = DA_GN_pat_recuverinator
		remove_country_modifier = DA_GN_pat_recuverinator_1
		remove_country_modifier = DA_GN_pat_recuverinator_2
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_on.dynamos }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GN_on_count value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GN_Mechanist }
			change_variable = { which = DA_GN_booked_capacity value = 8 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GN_Mechanist } }
			change_variable = { which = DA_GN_booked_capacity value = 10 }
		}
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GN_pat_dynamos duration = -1 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_up.dynamos.1 }
			add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GN_pat_dynamos_1 duration = -1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_up.dynamos.2 }
			add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GN_pat_dynamos_2 duration = -1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_on.dynamos } }
		remove_country_modifier = DA_GN_pat_dynamos
		remove_country_modifier = DA_GN_pat_dynamos_1
		remove_country_modifier = DA_GN_pat_dynamos_2
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_on.bombards }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GN_on_count value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GN_Mechanist }
			change_variable = { which = DA_GN_booked_capacity value = 8 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GN_Mechanist } }
			change_variable = { which = DA_GN_booked_capacity value = 10 }
		}
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GN_pat_bombards duration = -1 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_up.bombards.1 }
			add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GN_pat_bombards_1 duration = -1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_up.bombards.2 }
			add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GN_pat_bombards_2 duration = -1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_on.bombards } }
		remove_country_modifier = DA_GN_pat_bombards
		remove_country_modifier = DA_GN_pat_bombards_1
		remove_country_modifier = DA_GN_pat_bombards_2
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_on.crammers }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GN_on_count value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GN_Mechanist }
			change_variable = { which = DA_GN_booked_capacity value = 8 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GN_Mechanist } }
			change_variable = { which = DA_GN_booked_capacity value = 10 }
		}
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GN_pat_crammers duration = -1 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_up.crammers.1 }
			add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GN_pat_crammers_1 duration = -1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_up.crammers.2 }
			add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GN_pat_crammers_2 duration = -1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_on.crammers } }
		remove_country_modifier = DA_GN_pat_crammers
		remove_country_modifier = DA_GN_pat_crammers_1
		remove_country_modifier = DA_GN_pat_crammers_2
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_on.spyglass }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GN_on_count value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GN_Mechanist }
			change_variable = { which = DA_GN_booked_capacity value = 16 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GN_Mechanist } }
			change_variable = { which = DA_GN_booked_capacity value = 20 }
		}
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GN_pat_spyglass duration = -1 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_up.spyglass.1 }
			add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GN_pat_spyglass_1 duration = -1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_up.spyglass.2 }
			add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GN_pat_spyglass_2 duration = -1 }

DA_GN_switch_on_cocolocogram = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GN_Mechanist }
		add_treasury = -75
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GN_Mechanist } }
		add_treasury = -100
	}
	custom_tooltip = DA_GN_on_go_tt.cocolocogram
	hidden_effect = {
		set_country_flag = DA_GN_on.cocolocogram
		DA_GN_reconcile_capacity = yes
	}
}
DA_GN_switch_off_cocolocogram = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_GN_off_go_tt.cocolocogram
	hidden_effect = {
		clr_country_flag = DA_GN_on.cocolocogram
		clr_country_flag = DA_GN_switch.cocolocogram
		set_country_flag = DA_GN_switch.cocolocogram
		DA_GN_reconcile_capacity = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GN_lic_count value = 1 } }
			DA_GN_licences_upkeep = yes	# its licences end
		}
	}
}

		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GN_lic_count value = 1 } }
			DA_GN_licences_upkeep = yes	# its licences end
		}
	}
}
DA_GN_switch_on_cranes = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GN_Mechanist }
		add_treasury = -150
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GN_Mechanist } }
		add_treasury = -200
	}
	custom_tooltip = DA_GN_on_go_tt.cranes
	hidden_effect = {
		set_country_flag = DA_GN_on.cranes
		DA_GN_reconcile_capacity = yes
	}
}

# Yearly: while capacity is short, the dearest patent switches off (tier III first, the last of a tier first).
DA_GN_over_capacity = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_GN_on.bulkheads
			NOT = { check_variable = { which = RemainingArtificePoints value = 0 } }
		}
		DA_GN_switch_off_bulkheads = yes
		set_country_flag = DA_GN_overcap.bulkheads
		set_country_flag = DA_GN_overcap
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_GN_on.arcades
			NOT = { check_variable = { which = RemainingArtificePoints value = 0 } }
		}
		DA_GN_switch_off_arcades = yes
		set_country_flag = DA_GN_overcap.arcades
		set_country_flag = DA_GN_overcap
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_GN_on.ledgers
			NOT = { check_variable = { which = RemainingArtificePoints value = 0 } }
		}
		DA_GN_switch_off_ledgers = yes
		set_country_flag = DA_GN_overcap.ledgers
		set_country_flag = DA_GN_overcap
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_GN_on.walking
			NOT = { check_variable = { which = RemainingArtificePoints value = 0 } }
		}
		DA_GN_switch_off_walking = yes
		set_country_flag = DA_GN_overcap.walking
		set_country_flag = DA_GN_overcap
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_GN_on.lockers
			NOT = { check_variable = { which = RemainingArtificePoints value = 0 } }
		}
		DA_GN_switch_off_lockers = yes
		set_country_flag = DA_GN_overcap.lockers
		set_country_flag = DA_GN_overcap
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_GN_on.lenses
			NOT = { check_variable = { which = RemainingArtificePoints value = 0 } }
		}
		DA_GN_switch_off_lenses = yes
		set_country_flag = DA_GN_overcap.lenses
		set_country_flag = DA_GN_overcap
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_GN_on.tugs
			NOT = { check_variable = { which = RemainingArtificePoints value = 0 } }
		}
		DA_GN_switch_off_tugs = yes
		set_country_flag = DA_GN_overcap.tugs
		set_country_flag = DA_GN_overcap
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_GN_on.cranes
			NOT = { check_variable = { which = RemainingArtificePoints value = 0 } }
		}
		DA_GN_switch_off_cranes = yes
		set_country_flag = DA_GN_overcap.cranes
		set_country_flag = DA_GN_overcap
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_GN_on.looms
			NOT = { check_variable = { which = RemainingArtificePoints value = 0 } }
		}
		DA_GN_switch_off_looms = yes
		set_country_flag = DA_GN_overcap.looms
		set_country_flag = DA_GN_overcap
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_GN_on.monocles
			NOT = { check_variable = { which = RemainingArtificePoints value = 0 } }
		}
		DA_GN_switch_off_monocles = yes
		set_country_flag = DA_GN_overcap.monocles
		set_country_flag = DA_GN_overcap
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_GN_on.spyglass
			NOT = { check_variable = { which = RemainingArtificePoints value = 0 } }
		}
		DA_GN_switch_off_spyglass = yes
		set_country_flag = DA_GN_overcap.spyglass
		set_country_flag = DA_GN_overcap
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_GN_on.crammers
			NOT = { check_variable = { which = RemainingArtificePoints value = 0 } }
		}
		DA_GN_switch_off_crammers = yes
		set_country_flag = DA_GN_overcap.crammers
		set_country_flag = DA_GN_overcap
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_GN_on.bombards
			NOT = { check_variable = { which = RemainingArtificePoints value = 0 } }
		}
		DA_GN_switch_off_bombards = yes
		set_country_flag = DA_GN_overcap.bombards
		set_country_flag = DA_GN_overcap
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_GN_on.dynamos
			NOT = { check_variable = { which = RemainingArtificePoints value = 0 } }
		}
		DA_GN_switch_off_dynamos = yes
		set_country_flag = DA_GN_overcap.dynamos
		set_country_flag = DA_GN_overcap
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_GN_on.recuverinator
			NOT = { check_variable = { which = RemainingArtificePoints value = 0 } }
		}
		DA_GN_switch_off_recuverinator = yes
		set_country_flag = DA_GN_overcap.recuverinator
		set_country_flag = DA_GN_overcap
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_GN_on.cocolocogram
			NOT = { check_variable = { which = RemainingArtificePoints value = 0 } }
		}
		DA_GN_switch_off_cocolocogram = yes
		set_country_flag = DA_GN_overcap.cocolocogram
		set_country_flag = DA_GN_overcap
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_overcap ai = no }
		country_event = { id = DA_GN_event.6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_overcap ai = yes }
		clr_country_flag = DA_GN_overcap.cocolocogram
		clr_country_flag = DA_GN_overcap.recuverinator
		clr_country_flag = DA_GN_overcap.dynamos
		clr_country_flag = DA_GN_overcap.bombards
		clr_country_flag = DA_GN_overcap.crammers
		clr_country_flag = DA_GN_overcap.spyglass
		clr_country_flag = DA_GN_overcap.monocles
		clr_country_flag = DA_GN_overcap.looms
		clr_country_flag = DA_GN_overcap.cranes
		clr_country_flag = DA_GN_overcap.tugs
		clr_country_flag = DA_GN_overcap.walking
		clr_country_flag = DA_GN_overcap.ledgers
		clr_country_flag = DA_GN_overcap.arcades
		clr_country_flag = DA_GN_overcap.bulkheads
		clr_country_flag = DA_GN_overcap.lenses
		clr_country_flag = DA_GN_overcap.lockers
		clr_country_flag = DA_GN_overcap.coils
		clr_country_flag = DA_GN_overcap
	}
}
DA_GN_counts = {
	set_variable = { which = DA_GN_proto_count value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_GN_pre_count value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_proto.cocolocogram }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GN_proto_count value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_proto.recuverinator }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GN_proto_count value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_proto.dynamos }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GN_proto_count value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_proto.bombards }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GN_proto_count value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_proto.crammers }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GN_proto_count value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_proto.spyglass }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GN_proto_count value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_proto.monocles }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GN_proto_count value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_proto.looms }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GN_proto_count value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_proto.cranes }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GN_proto_count value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_proto.tugs }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GN_proto_count value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_proto.walking }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GN_proto_count value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_proto.ledgers }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GN_proto_count value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_proto.arcades }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GN_proto_count value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_proto.bulkheads }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GN_proto_count value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_pre.lenses }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GN_pre_count value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_pre.lockers }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GN_pre_count value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_pre.coils }
		change_variable = { which = DA_GN_pre_count value = 1 }
	}
	export_to_variable = { which = DA_GN_innov value = trigger_value:innovativeness }
}

# ---- The lead school ----
# The charter, or later an organization of none of the three schools: ask once.
DA_GN_lead_school_check = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			DA_GN_lead_needs_pick = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_lead_asked }
		}
		set_country_flag = DA_GN_lead_asked
		country_event = { id = DA_GN_event.4 }
	}
}
DA_GN_pick_lead = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_GN_lead_pick.brillite
	clr_country_flag = DA_GN_lead_pick.mechanist
	clr_country_flag = DA_GN_lead_pick.thaumaturge
	set_country_flag = DA_GN_lead_pick.$school$
	clr_country_flag = DA_GN_lead_asked
}
# Grand Synthesis: once every 20 years, a school of our choice leads whatever the organization.
DA_GN_override_lead = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_GN_lead_override.brillite
	clr_country_flag = DA_GN_lead_override.mechanist
	clr_country_flag = DA_GN_lead_override.thaumaturge
	set_country_flag = DA_GN_lead_override
	set_country_flag = DA_GN_lead_override.$school$
	clr_country_flag = DA_GN_lead_changed
	set_country_flag = DA_GN_lead_changed
}
DA_GN_follow_org = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_GN_lead_override
	clr_country_flag = DA_GN_lead_override.brillite
	clr_country_flag = DA_GN_lead_override.mechanist
	clr_country_flag = DA_GN_lead_override.thaumaturge
	clr_country_flag = DA_GN_lead_changed
	set_country_flag = DA_GN_lead_changed
}

# ---- The window (topbar.gui, DA_GN_workshop) ----
DA_GN_open_workshop = {
	set_country_flag = DA_GN_workshop_on
	DA_GN_refresh = yes
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_GN_sel value = 1 } } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_GN_sel value = 1 }
	}
}
DA_GN_close_workshop = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_GN_workshop_on
}
DA_GN_refresh = {
	DA_GN_reconcile_capacity = yes
	DA_GN_counts = yes
	DA_GN_job_percent = yes
}
# The heritage turns active or dormant (DA_RH_sync_gnomish): patents switch off, their capacity is freed; the
# branches and licences follow; the Dragonbreaker flag of the Legendary Encounters.
DA_GN_sync = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { DA_RH_active_gnomish = yes }
			OR = {
				DA_GN_any_on = yes
				check_variable = { which = DA_GN_booked_capacity value = 1 }
			}
		}
		DA_GN_reconcile_capacity = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { DA_RH_active_gnomish = yes }
			has_country_flag = DA_GN_workshop_on
		}
		DA_GN_close_workshop = yes
	}
	DA_GN_harpoons_flag = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GN_Branches }
		DA_GN_branches_upkeep = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GN_lic_count value = 1 } }
		DA_GN_licences_upkeep = yes
	}
}
# Dragonbreaker Harpoons: the flag that build_legendary_encounters.py reads (le_rules.ARMY_BONUS).
DA_GN_harpoons_flag = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GN_Harpoons DA_RH_active_gnomish = yes }
		set_country_flag = DA_GN_dragonbreaker
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_GN_dragonbreaker
			NOT = { AND = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GN_Harpoons DA_RH_active_gnomish = yes } }
		}
		clr_country_flag = DA_GN_dragonbreaker
	}
}

# ---- Gommo Branches: counted again, the lost ones closed, the hosts' modifier renewed (400 days), our capacity ----
DA_GN_branches_upkeep = {
	set_variable = { which = DA_GN_branch_count value = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_branch_@ROOT }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { OR = { alliance_with = ROOT is_subject_of = ROOT } } }
			clr_country_flag = DA_GN_branch_@ROOT
			capital_scope = { remove_province_modifier = DA_GN_gommo_branch }
			ROOT = { set_country_flag = DA_GN_branch_closed }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_branch_@ROOT }
			ROOT = { change_variable = { which = DA_GN_branch_count value = 1 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = DA_GN_branch_@ROOT
				ROOT = { DA_RH_active_gnomish = yes }
			}
			capital_scope = { add_province_modifier = { name = DA_GN_gommo_branch duration = 400 } }
		}
	}
	remove_country_modifier = DA_GN_branches_1
	remove_country_modifier = DA_GN_branches_2
	remove_country_modifier = DA_GN_branches_3
	if = {
		limit = {
			DA_RH_active_gnomish = yes
			check_variable = { which = DA_GN_branch_count value = 1 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_GN_branch_count value = 2 } }
		}
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GN_branches_1 duration = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			DA_RH_active_gnomish = yes
			check_variable = { which = DA_GN_branch_count value = 2 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_GN_branch_count value = 3 } }
		}
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GN_branches_2 duration = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			DA_RH_active_gnomish = yes
			check_variable = { which = DA_GN_branch_count value = 3 }
		}
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_GN_branches_3 duration = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_branch_closed }
		clr_country_flag = DA_GN_branch_closed
		if = {
			limit = { ai = no }
			country_event = { id = DA_GN_event.9 }
		}
	}
	DA_GN_reconcile_capacity = yes	# Anbennar counts the artifice capacity again
}
# ---- Licences: counted again; a licence ends when its patent is off, its licensee no longer our ally or subject,
# our heritage dormant, or its 15 years are over (the modifier is gone) ----
DA_GN_licences_upkeep = {
	set_variable = { which = DA_GN_lic_count value = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_lic_cocolocogram_@ROOT }
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_GN_lic_cocolocogram }
					NOT = { OR = { alliance_with = ROOT is_subject_of = ROOT } }
					ROOT = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_on.cocolocogram } }
					ROOT = { NOT = { DA_RH_active_gnomish = yes } }
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = DA_GN_lic_cocolocogram_@ROOT
			remove_country_modifier = DA_GN_lic_cocolocogram
		}
		if = {

		}

# Yearly: every licensee pays its fee.

# ---- Pulses (DA_GN_on_actions.txt) ----
DA_GN_startup = {
	DA_GN_corps_check = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				DA_GN_any_on = yes
				check_variable = { which = DA_GN_booked_capacity value = 1 }
			}
		}
		DA_GN_reconcile_capacity = yes
	}
}
DA_GN_yearly = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_RH_had.gnomish }
		DA_GN_corps_check = yes
		DA_GN_lead_school_check = yes
		# Universal Sprockets: +1 of each material a year
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GN_Sprockets DA_RH_active_gnomish = yes }
			change_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = 1 }
			change_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = 1 }
			change_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_reagents_total value = 1 }
		}
		# Settler Charters: Reclaimed Homeland in our provinces of the Dragon Coast
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GN_Settlers DA_RH_active_gnomish = yes }
			every_owned_province = {
				limit = { region = dragon_coast_region }
				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_GN_reclaimed_homeland duration = 400 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					DA_GN_any_on = yes
					check_variable = { which = DA_GN_booked_capacity value = 1 }
				}
			}
			DA_GN_reconcile_capacity = yes
			DA_GN_over_capacity = yes
		}
		# The Patent Economy: royalties for each patent switched on
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GN_Patent_Economy DA_RH_active_gnomish = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GN_on_count value = 1 } }
				add_treasury = 12
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GN_on_count value = 2 } }
				add_treasury = 12
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GN_on_count value = 3 } }
				add_treasury = 12
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GN_on_count value = 4 } }
				add_treasury = 12
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GN_on_count value = 5 } }
				add_treasury = 12
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GN_on_count value = 6 } }
				add_treasury = 12
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GN_on_count value = 7 } }
				add_treasury = 12
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GN_on_count value = 8 } }
				add_treasury = 12
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GN_on_count value = 9 } }
				add_treasury = 12
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GN_on_count value = 10 } }
				add_treasury = 12
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GN_on_count value = 11 } }
				add_treasury = 12
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GN_on_count value = 12 } }
				add_treasury = 12
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GN_on_count value = 13 } }
				add_treasury = 12
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GN_on_count value = 14 } }
				add_treasury = 12
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GN_on_count value = 15 } }
				add_treasury = 12
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GN_on_count value = 16 } }
				add_treasury = 12
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GN_on_count value = 17 } }
				add_treasury = 12
			}
		}
		# The International Gommo and the Great Ideation Engine: innovativeness every year
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GN_International DA_RH_active_gnomish = yes }
			change_innovativeness = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { DA_GN_engine_on = yes }
			change_innovativeness = 1
		}
		# Branches: the lost ones close, the hosts' modifier is renewed
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GN_Branches }
			DA_GN_branches_upkeep = yes
		}
		# Licences: the ended ones close, the others pay; an offer nobody answered in 60 days is dropped
		if = {
			limit = { had_country_flag = { flag = DA_GN_lic_pending days = 60 } }
			clr_country_flag = DA_GN_lic_pending
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_GN_lic_count value = 1 } }
			DA_GN_licences_upkeep = yes
			DA_GN_licence_fees = yes
		}
		DA_GN_harpoons_flag = yes
		# The E++ Patent Dispute: once per game, a chance a year while a goblin neighbour has E++
		if = {
			limit = { DA_GN_eplus_ready = yes }
			random = { chance = 25 country_event = { id = DA_GN_event.13 } }
		}
	}
}

# One prototype: the first patent of the register whose tile is done.

# One patent switched on, while at least half the free capacity stays free.
